nodes.name: Convergence rates and monotone approximations of local conservation laws
nodes.statement: For local conservation laws, the vanishing viscosity approximation (obtained by adding a parabolic regularization term varepsilon partial_xx^2 rho_varepsilon) and monotone numerical schemes are known to converge to the entropy solution with at most first-order accuracy (see ). Although viscous approximations and monotone schemes are formally first-order, they may lose half-order accuracy across shocks. Indeed, Kuznetsov's O(sqrtvarepsilon) or O(sqrth) convergence rates (see and also ) is indeed optimal for all monotone approximations applied to linear advection equations (see in ) as well as for genuinely nonlinear fluxes in the case of BV data (see ). For the special case of monotonic initial data, rates of O(varepsilon|log varepsilon|) or O(h |log h|) have been obtained and are optimal (see ). This also holds for piecewise smooth initial data, as proven in , where the rate is actually O(varepsilon) or O(h) for initial data with non-interacting shocks, provided that no shocks form at later times as well. In crefssec:num-convergence, we present numerical investigations of the convergence rates. For Riemann shock initial data, the rate appears to reach O(varepsilon + h), whereas for Riemann rarefaction initial data it lies between O(varepsilon + h) and O(sqrtvarepsilon + sqrth). A more detailed study of the optimality of the rate in crefeq:rate-thm will be addressed in future work.

\label{rk:local-convergence-references}

For local conservation laws, the vanishing viscosity approximation (obtained by adding a parabolic regularization term ${\varepsilon} \partial_{xx}^2 \rho_{\varepsilon}$) and monotone numerical schemes are known to converge to the entropy solution with at most first-order accuracy (see \cite{MR551288,MR413526}). 

Although viscous approximations and monotone schemes are formally first-order, they may lose half-order accuracy across shocks. Indeed, Kuznetsov's $O(\sqrt{{\varepsilon}})$ or $O(\sqrt{h})$ convergence rates (see \cite{MR483509} and also \cite{MR811184,MR679435,MR1111445}) is indeed optimal for all monotone approximations applied to linear advection equations (see in \cite{MR1270625}) as well as for genuinely nonlinear fluxes in the case of BV data (see \cite{MR1480382}). 

For the special case of monotonic initial data, rates of $O({\varepsilon}|\log {\varepsilon}|)$ or $O(h |\log h|)$ have been obtained and are optimal (see \cite{MR929127}). This also holds for piecewise smooth initial data, as proven in \cite{MR1397446,MR1451109,MR1646744}, where the rate is actually $O({\varepsilon})$ or $O(h)$ for initial data with non-interacting shocks, provided that no shocks form at later times as well.

In \cref{ssec:num-convergence}, we present numerical investigations of the convergence rates. For Riemann shock initial data, the rate appears to reach $O(\varepsilon + h)$, whereas for Riemann rarefaction initial data it lies between $O(\varepsilon + h)$ and $O(\sqrt{\varepsilon} + \sqrt{h})$. A more detailed study of the optimality of the rate in \cref{eq:rate-thm} will be addressed in future work.

For the second term on the right-hand side of crefeq:tv_tmp, owing to crefeq:TV-p1 in creflm:use_for_tv, we have &sum_k=1^infty left(gamma_k-1^varepsilon,h+gamma_k+1^varepsilon,h-2gamma_k^varepsilon,hright) sum_jinZrho_j+k^n left|V(W_j+k+1^n) -V(W_j^n)right| \\ &leq sum_k=1^infty left(gamma_k-1^varepsilon,h+gamma_k+1^varepsilon,h-2gamma_k^varepsilon,hright) sum_jinZ left(sum_l=0^k rho_j+l^nright) left|V(W_j+1^n) -V(W_j^n)right| \\ &= sum_jinZ left( sum_k=1^infty left(gamma_k+1^varepsilon,h-gamma_k^varepsilon,hright) sum_l=0^k rho_j+l^n - sum_k=1^infty left(gamma_k^varepsilon,h-gamma_k-1^varepsilon,hright) sum_l=0^k rho_j+l^n right) left|V(W_j+1^n) -V(W_j^n)right| \\ &= sum_jinZ left( -sum_k=0^infty left(gamma_k+1^varepsilon,h-gamma_k^varepsilon,hright) rho_j+k+1^n - left(gamma_1^varepsilon,h-gamma_0^varepsilon,hright) rho_j^n right) left|V(W_j+1^n) -V(W_j^n)right| \\ &= sum_jinZ left( W_j+1^n-W_j^n + left(2gamma_0^varepsilon,h-gamma_1^varepsilon,hright)rho_j^n right) left|V(W_j+1^n)-V(W_j^n)right| \\ &= sum_jinZ -alpha_j^n left( W_j+1^n-W_j^n+ left(2gamma_0^varepsilon,h-gamma_1^varepsilon,hright)rho_j^n right) left|W_j+1^n-W_j^nright| \\ &= sum_jinZ left( V(W_j^n)-V(W_j+1^n) - left(2gamma_0^varepsilon,h-gamma_1^varepsilon,hright)rho_j^nalpha_j^n right) |W_j+1^n-W_j^n|. From \cref{eq:W-2}, we have 
\begin{align*}
    &W_{j+1}^{n+1} - W_j^{n+1} \\
    &= W_{j+1}^n - W_j^n - \lambda \sum_{k=0}^\infty \gamma_k^{{\varepsilon},h} \rho_{j+k+1}^n V(W_{j+k+2}^n) + 2 \lambda \sum_{k=0}^\infty \gamma_k^{{\varepsilon},h} \rho_{j+k}^n V(W_{j+k+1}^n) \\ & \qquad - \lambda \sum_{k=0}^\infty \gamma_k^{{\varepsilon},h} \rho_{j+k-1}^n V(W_{j+k}^n) \\
    &= W_{j+1}^n - W_j^n + \lambda \left(2\gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h} - \gamma_1^{{\varepsilon},h}\right) \rho_j^n V(W_{j+1}^n) - \lambda \gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h} \rho_{j-1}^n V(W_j^n) \\
    &\qquad + \lambda \sum_{k=1}^\infty \left(2\gamma_k^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_{k-1}^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_{k+1}^{{\varepsilon},h}\right) \rho_{j+k}^n V(W_{j+k+1}^n) \\
    &= W_{j+1}^n - W_j^n + \lambda \left(2\gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h} - \gamma_1^{{\varepsilon},h}\right) \rho_j^n V(W_{j+1}^n) - \lambda \gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h} \rho_{j-1}^n V(W_j^n) \\ & \qquad  + \lambda V(W_j^n) \left( 2\left(W_j^n-\gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h} \rho_j^n\right) - W_{j+1}^n  - \left(W_{j-1}^n - \gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h} \rho_{j-1}^n - \gamma_1^{{\varepsilon},h} \rho_j^n\right) \right) \\
    &\qquad + \lambda \sum_{k=1}^\infty \left(2\gamma_k^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_{k-1}^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_{k+1}^{{\varepsilon},h}\right) \rho_{j+k}^n \left(V(W_{j+k+1}^n) -V(W_j^n)\right) \\
    &= W_{j+1}^n - W_j^n + \lambda \left(2\gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h} - \gamma_1^{{\varepsilon},h}\right) \rho_j^n \left(V(W_{j+1}^n) - V(W_j^n)\right) + V(W_j^n) (2W_j^n - W_{j-1}^n - W_{j+1}^n) \\
    &\qquad + \lambda \sum_{k=1}^\infty \left(2\gamma_k^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_{k-1}^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_{k+1}^{{\varepsilon},h}\right) \rho_{j+k}^n \left(V(W_{j+k+1}^n) -V(W_j^n)\right) \\
    &= \lambda V(W_j^n)(W_j^n - W_{j-1}^n) + \left( 1-\lambda V(W_j^n) + \lambda \left(2\gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_1^{{\varepsilon},h}\right) \rho_j^n\alpha_j^n \right) (W_{j+1}^n - W_j^n) \\
    &\qquad + \lambda \sum_{k=1}^\infty \left(2\gamma_k^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_{k-1}^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_{k+1}^{{\varepsilon},h}\right) \rho_{j+k}^n \left(V(W_{j+k+1}^n) -V(W_j^n)\right),
\end{align*}
where $\alpha_j^n\coloneqq\frac{V(W_{j+1}^n) - V(W_j^n)}{W_{j+1}^n - W_j^n}$. From this, we obtain
\begin{align}\label{eq:tv_tmp}
    \sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}} |W_{j+1}^{n+1} - W_j^{n+1}| &\leq \sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}\!\Big( 1 + \lambda \Big(2\gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_1^{{\varepsilon},h}\Big) \rho_j^n\alpha_j^n + \lambda(V(W_{j+1}^n)-V(W_j^n)) \Big) |W_{j+1}^n \!-\! W_j^n| \\
    &\qquad + \lambda \sum_{k=1}^\infty \Big(\gamma_{k-1}^{{\varepsilon},h}+\gamma_{k+1}^{{\varepsilon},h}-2\gamma_k^{{\varepsilon},h}\Big) \sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}\rho_{j+k}^n \left|V(W_{j+k+1}^n) -V(W_j^n)\right|, \notag
\end{align}
where we have used the CFL condition \cref{ass:CFL} to ensure 
\[ 
1 + \lambda \left(2\gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_1^{{\varepsilon},h}\right) \rho_j^n\alpha_j^n + \lambda\left(V(W_{j+1}^n)-V(W_j^n)\right)\geq0,
\] 
and the condition \cref{ass:convexity} to give $\gamma_{k-1}^{{\varepsilon},h}+\gamma_{k+1}^{{\varepsilon},h}-2\gamma_k^{{\varepsilon},h}\geq0$.

For the second term on the right-hand side of \cref{eq:tv_tmp}, owing to \cref{eq:TV-p1} in \cref{lm:use_for_tv}, we have 
\begin{align*}
    &\sum_{k=1}^\infty \left(\gamma_{k-1}^{{\varepsilon},h}+\gamma_{k+1}^{{\varepsilon},h}-2\gamma_k^{{\varepsilon},h}\right) \sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}\rho_{j+k}^n \left|V(W_{j+k+1}^n) -V(W_j^n)\right| \\
    &\leq \sum_{k=1}^\infty \left(\gamma_{k-1}^{{\varepsilon},h}+\gamma_{k+1}^{{\varepsilon},h}-2\gamma_k^{{\varepsilon},h}\right) \sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}} \left(\sum_{l=0}^k \rho_{j+l}^n\right) \left|V(W_{j+1}^n) -V(W_j^n)\right| \\
    &= \sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}} \left( \sum_{k=1}^\infty \left(\gamma_{k+1}^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_k^{{\varepsilon},h}\right) \sum_{l=0}^k \rho_{j+l}^n - \sum_{k=1}^\infty \left(\gamma_k^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_{k-1}^{{\varepsilon},h}\right) \sum_{l=0}^k \rho_{j+l}^n \right) \left|V(W_{j+1}^n) -V(W_j^n)\right| \\
    &= \sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}} \left( -\sum_{k=0}^\infty \left(\gamma_{k+1}^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_k^{{\varepsilon},h}\right) \rho_{j+k+1}^n - \left(\gamma_1^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h}\right) \rho_j^n \right) \left|V(W_{j+1}^n) -V(W_j^n)\right| \\
    &= \sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}} \left( W_{j+1}^n-W_j^n + \left(2\gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_1^{{\varepsilon},h}\right)\rho_j^n \right) \left|V(W_{j+1}^n)-V(W_j^n)\right| \\
    &= \sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}} -\alpha_j^n \left( W_{j+1}^n-W_j^n+ \left(2\gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_1^{{\varepsilon},h}\right)\rho_j^n \right) \left|W_{j+1}^n-W_j^n\right| \\
    &= \sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}} \left( V(W_j^n)-V(W_{j+1}^n) - \left(2\gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_1^{{\varepsilon},h}\right)\rho_j^n\alpha_j^n \right) |W_{j+1}^n-W_j^n|.
\end{align*}
In the last two lines, we have used the fact that $\alpha_j^n=\frac{V(W_{j+1}^n)-V(W_j^n)}{W_{j+1}^n-W_j^n}\leq0$.

Combining the above estimates, we deduce that
\begin{align*}
    \sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}} |W_{j+1}^{n+1} - W_j^{n+1}| \leq& \sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}\left( 1 + \lambda \left(2\gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_1^{{\varepsilon},h}\right) \rho_j^n\alpha_j^n + \lambda\left(V(W_{j+1}^n)-V(W_j^n)\right) \right) |W_{j+1}^n - W_j^n| \\
    &\qquad + \lambda \sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}} \left( V(W_j^n)-V(W_{j+1}^n) - \left(2\gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_1^{{\varepsilon},h}\right)\rho_j^n\alpha_j^n \right) |W_{j+1}^n-W_j^n| \\

\end{align*}
Therefore, we conclude that 
\[

From \cref{eq:W-2}, we have 
\begin{align*}
    W_j^{n+1}-c 
    &= W_j^n-c + \lambda \sum_{k=0}^\infty \gamma_k^{{\varepsilon},h} \left( \rho_{j+k-1}^n \left(V(W_{j+k}^n)-V(c)\right) - \rho_{j+k}^n \left(V(W_{j+k+1}^n)-V(c)\right) \right) \\ &\qquad + \lambda V(c) (W_{j-1}^n-W_j^n) \\
    &= \left(1-\lambda V(c)\right) (W_j^n-c) + \lambda V(c) (W_{j-1}^n-c) \\
    &\qquad + \lambda \sum_{k=0}^\infty \gamma_k^{{\varepsilon},h} \left( \rho_{j+k-1}^n \left(V(W_{j+k}^n)-V(c)\right) - \rho_{j+k}^n \left(V(W_{j+k+1}^n)-V(c)\right) \right) \\
    &= \left(1-\lambda V(c)\right) (W_j^n-c) + \lambda V(c) (W_{j-1}^n-c) + \lambda \gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h}\rho_{j-1}^n \left(V(W_j^n)-V(c)\right) \\
    &\qquad +\lambda \sum_{k=0}^\infty \left(\gamma_{k+1}^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_k^{{\varepsilon},h}\right) \rho_{j+k}^n \left(V(W_{j+k+1}^n)-V(c)\right),
\end{align*}
where we have used the summation by parts in the last step. Noting that 
\[ \left|\lambda \gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h}\rho_{j-1}^n \left(V(W_j^n)-V(c)\right)\right| \leq \lambda \|V'\|_{\mathrm{L}^\infty} |W_j^n-c| \leq \left(1-\lambda V(c)\right) |W_j^n-c|, \]
provided the CFL condition \cref{ass:CFL-max}, which implies that
\begin{align*}
    &\left|\left(1-\lambda V(c)\right) (W_j^n-c) + \lambda \gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h}\rho_{j-1}^n \left(V(W_j^n)-V(c)\right)\right| \\
    &= \sgn{W_j^n-c} \left( \left(1-\lambda V(c)\right) (W_j^n-c) + \lambda \gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h}\rho_{j-1}^n \left(V(W_j^n)-V(c)\right) \right) \\
    &= \left(1-\lambda V(c)\right) |W_j^n-c| - \lambda \gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h}\rho_{j-1}^n \left|V(W_j^n)-V(c)\right|.
\end{align*}
Then we obtain
\begin{align*}
    |W_j^{n+1}-c| 
    &\leq (1-\lambda V(c)) |W_j^n-c| + \lambda V(c) |W_{j-1}^n-c| - \lambda \gamma_0^{{\varepsilon},h}\rho_{j-1}^n \left|V(W_j^n)-V(c)\right| \\
    &\qquad -\lambda \sum_{k=0}^\infty \left(\gamma_{k+1}^{{\varepsilon},h}-\gamma_k^{{\varepsilon},h}\right) \rho_{j+k}^n \left|V(W_{j+k+1}^n)-V(c)\right| \\
    &= |W_j^n-c| + \lambda V(c) \left(|W_{j-1}^n-c|-|W_j^n-c|\right) \\
    &\qquad -\lambda \sum_{k=0}^\infty \gamma_k^{{\varepsilon},h} \rho_{j+k-1}^n \left|V(W_{j+k}^n)-V(c)\right| +\lambda \sum_{k=0}^\infty \gamma_k^{{\varepsilon},h} \rho_{j+k}^n \left|V(W_{j+k+1}^n)-V(c)\right| \\
    &= |W_j^n-c| + \lambda (\Psi_{j-1/2}^n - \Psi_{j+1/2}^n),
\end{align*}
which leads to the desired entropy inequality \crefrange{eq:discrete-entropy-2}{eq:entropy-flux-2}.

\nu(v, \sigma)&\coloneqq \sup _{t \in[0, T]} \nu_t(v, \sigma), \qquad \mathrm{for\ all}\ \sigma>0, \\
\Lambda_T(v, \phi, c)&\coloneqq  \int_0^T \int_{\mathbb{R}}\left(|v-c| \partial_t \phi+\psi_c(v) \partial_x \phi\right) \, \mathrm d x \, \mathrm d t -\int_{\mathbb{R}}|v(T,x)-c| \phi(T,x) \, \mathrm  d x \\
& \qquad\qquad +\int_{\mathbb{R}}|v(0,x)-c| \phi(0,x) \, \mathrm d x, \qquad \mathrm{for\ all}\ \phi \in \mathrm{C}_\mathrm{c}^1(\mathbb{R}_+\times\mathbb{R},\mathbb{R}_+) ,\, c\in\mathbb{R}, \\
\Lambda_{\delta, \delta_0}(v, u)&\coloneqq  \int_0^T \int_{\mathbb{R}} \Lambda_T\left(v, \Omega\left(\cdot, t^{\prime}, \cdot, x^{\prime}\right), u\left(t^{\prime},x^{\prime}\right)\right) \, \mathrm d x^{\prime} \, \mathrm d t', 
\end{align*}

nodes.name: Proof of \cref{th:rate}
nodes.statement: We first assume T=Ntau for NinN_+ and apply creflm:kut to v=W_varepsilon,h and u=rho, using the flux function f(rho)=rho V(rho) and Kruvzkov's entropy flux function psi_c(xi)=sgnxi-c(xi V(xi) - cV(c)). We denote t_ncoloneqq ntau for ngeq0 and x_j-1/2coloneqq(j-frac12)h for jinZ. It is straightforward to verify that W_varepsilon,hinK. Then creflm:kut gives \|W_varepsilon,h(T-,cdot)-rho(T,cdot)\|_L^1 &leq left\|W_varepsilon,h(0,cdot)-rho_0right\|_L^1+TVleft(rho_0right)left(2 delta+delta_0\|V\|_W^1,inftyright) \\ & +nuleft(W_varepsilon,h, delta_0right)-Lambda_delta, delta_0(W_varepsilon,h, rho), for any 0<delta_0<T and delta>0, where nu and Lambda_delta, delta_0 are as defined in the statement of creflm:kut. ulineStep 1. For the first term left\|W_varepsilon,h(0,cdot)-rho_0right\|_L^1, we have left\|W_varepsilon,h(0,cdot)-rho_0right\|_L^1 leq left\|W_varepsilon,h(0,cdot)-rho_varepsilon,h(0,cdot)right\|_L^1 + left\|rho_varepsilon,h(0,cdot)-rho_0right\|_L^1, where left\|W_varepsilon,h(0,cdot)-rho_varepsilon,h(0,cdot)right\|_L^1 = hsum_jinZ |W_j^0-rho_j^0| leq h sum_k=0^infty kgamma_k^varepsilon,hsum_jinZ |rho_j+1^0-rho_j^0| leq c_gammavarepsilon \, TV(rho_0), with c_gamma specified in crefass:gamma-mom, and left\|rho_varepsilon,h(0,cdot)-rho_0right\|_L^1 = sum_jinZ int_x_j-1/2^x_j+1/2 |rho_0(x)-rho_j^0|\, dx leq h \, TV(rho_0). Therefore, we have left\|W_varepsilon,h(0,cdot)-rho_0right\|_L^1 leq (c_gammavarepsilon+h)\, TV(rho_0). ulineStep 2. For the term nu(W_varepsilon,h, delta_0)=sup_tin[0,T]nu_t(W_varepsilon,h, delta_0), we first estimate \[ nu_t(W_varepsilon,h, delta_0)= sup_0leq sleqdelta_0 \|W_varepsilon,h(t+s,cdot)-W_varepsilon,h(t,cdot)\|_L^1. \] For any tin[0,T] and sin[0,delta_0], suppose that tin[t_m,t_m+1[ and t+sin[t_n,t_n+1[. Owing to the temporal TV-estimate crefeq:TVD-t-general in creflm:TVD-t-general, we have \|W_varepsilon,h(t+s,cdot)-W_varepsilon,h(t,cdot)\|_L^1 = sum_jinZ |W_j^n-W_j^m| h leq lambda (n-m)h normV_W^1,infty TV(rho_0). Noting that (n-m-1)taule s and tau=lambda h, and taking the supremum over sin[0,delta_0] and tin[0,T] in the above inequality, we obtain that nuleft(W_varepsilon,h, delta_0right) leq (delta_0+tau) normV_W^1,infty TV(rho_0). ulineStep 3. For the term Lambda_delta, delta_0(W_varepsilon,h, rho), we first consider Lambda_T(W_varepsilon,h, phi, c)= & int_0^T int_Rleft(|W_varepsilon,h-c| partial_t phi+psi_c(W_varepsilon,h) partial_x phiright) \, mathrm d x \, mathrm d t \\ & -int_R|W_varepsilon,h(T,x)-c| phi(T,x) \, mathrm d x+int_R|W_varepsilon,h(0,x)-c| phi(0,x) \, mathrm d x, where phiinC^1_c(R_+timesR,R_+) and cinR. We have &int_0^T int_Rleft(|W_varepsilon,h-c| partial_t phi+psi_c(W_varepsilon,h) partial_x phiright) \, mathrm d x \, mathrm d t \\ &= sum_n=0^N-1sum_jinZ |W_j^n-c| int_x_j-1/2^x_j+1/2 phi(t_n+1,x)-phi(t_n,x) \, dx + psi_c(W_j^n) int_t_n^t_n+1 phi(t,x_j+1/2)-phi(t,x_j-1/2)\, dt, and int_R|W_varepsilon,h(T,x)-c| phi(T,x) \, mathrm d x = sum_jinZ |W_j^N-c| int_x_j-1/2^x_j+1/2 phi(t_N,x) \, dx, \\ int_R|W_varepsilon,h(0,x)-c| phi(0,x) \, mathrm d x = sum_jinZ |W_j^0-c| int_x_j-1/2^x_j+1/2 phi(t_0,x) \, dx. Using summation by parts, we obtain &sum_n=0^N-1sum_jinZ |W_j^n-c| int_x_j-1/2^x_j+1/2 phi(t_n+1,x)-phi(t_n,x) \, dx \\ &= sum_n=0^N-1 sum_jinZ left( |W_j^n-c| - |W_j^n+1-c| right) int_x_j-1/2^x_j+1/2 phi(t_n+1,x) \, dx \\ & + sum_jinZ |W_j^0-c| int_x_j-1/2^x_j+1/2 phi(t_0,x) \, dx - sum_jinZ |W_j^N-c| int_x_j-1/2^x_j+1/2 phi(t_N,x) \, dx. and &sum_n=0^N-1sum_jinZ psi_c(W_j^n) int_t_n^t_n+1 phi(t,x_j+1/2)-phi(t,x_j-1/2)\, dt \\ &= sum_n=0^N-1sum_jinZ left( psi_c(W_j^n)-psi_c(W_j+1^n) right) int_t_n^t_n+1 phi(t,x_j+1/2) \, dt. Therefore, we deduce that Lambda_T(W_varepsilon,h, phi, c) &= sum_n=0^N-1 sum_jinZ left( |W_j^n-c| - |W_j^n+1-c| right) int_x_j-1/2^x_j+1/2 phi(t_n+1,x) \, dx \\ & + sum_n=0^N-1sum_jinZ left( psi_c(W_j^n)-psi_c(W_j+1^n) right) int_t_n^t_n+1 phi(t,x_j+1/2) \, dt. Next, we use the discrete entropy inequality crefrangeeq:discrete-entropy-2eq:entropy-flux-2 in creflm:discrete-entropy-2 to obtain Lambda_T(W_varepsilon,h, phi, c) &geq sum_n=0^N-1 sum_jinZ lambda (Psi_j+1/2^n - Psi_j-1/2^n) int_x_j-1/2^x_j+1/2 phi(t_n+1,x) \, dx \\ & + sum_n=0^N-1sum_jinZ left( psi_c(W_j^n)-psi_c(W_j+1^n) right) int_t_n^t_n+1 phi(t,x_j+1/2) \, dt \\ &= sum_n=0^N-1 sum_jinZ left( Psi_j-1/2^n - psi_c(W_j^n) right) int_t_n^t_n+1 phi(t,x_j-1/2) - phi(t,x_j+1/2) \, dt \\ & + sum_n=0^N-1sum_jinZ left( Psi_j+1/2^n - Psi_j-1/2^n right) left( lambda int_x_j-1/2^x_j+1/2 phi(t_n+1,x) \, dx - int_t_n^t_n+1 phi(t,x_j+1/2) \, dt right), where we have used summation by parts in the last step, and Psi_j-1/2^n is as defined in crefeq:entropy-flux-2. Now we take the particular test function Omega(t,t',x,x') = omega_delta_0(t-t')omega_delta(x-x') and estimate &Lambda_T(W_varepsilon,h, Omega(cdot,t',cdot,x'), c) \\ &geq -sum_n=0^N-1 sum_jinZ left| Psi_j-1/2^n - psi_c(W_j^n) right| I_j^n(t',x') - sum_n=0^N-1sum_jinZ left| Psi_j+1/2^n - Psi_j-1/2^n right| J_j^n(t',x'), notag where I_j^n(t',x') &coloneqq left| omega_delta(x_j-1/2-x') - omega_delta(x_j+1/2-x') right| int_t_n^t_n+1 omega_delta_0(t-t') \, dt, \\ J_j^n(t',x') &coloneqq left| lambda omega_delta_0(t_n+1-t') int_x_j-1/2^x_j+1/2 omega_delta(x-x') \, dx - omega_delta(x_j+1/2-x') int_t_n^t_n+1 omega_delta_0(t-t') \, dt right|. To proceed, we need to derive estimates on left|Psi_j-1/2^n - psi_c(W_j^n)right| and left|Psi_j+1/2^n - Psi_j-1/2^nright|. For left|Psi_j-1/2^n - psi_c(W_j^n)right|, we observe that psi_c(W_j^n) = |W_j^n-c|V(c) - W_j^nleft|V(W_j^n)-V(c)right|, thus left|Psi_j-1/2^n - psi_c(W_j^n)right| &leq |W_j^n-W_j-1^n| V(c) + |W_j^n-W_j-1^n|left|V(W_j^n)-V(c)right| \\ & + sum_k=0^infty gamma_k^varepsilon,h rho_j+k-1^n left|V(W_j+k^n)-V(W_j^n)right| \\ &leq 2normV_L^infty |W_j^n-W_j-1^n| + \|V'\|_L^infty sum_k=0^infty gamma_k^varepsilon,h |W_j+k^n-W_j^n| \\ &eqqcolon K_j^n. For left|Psi_j+1/2^n - Psi_j-1/2^nright|, we have left|Psi_j+1/2^n - Psi_j-1/2^nright| &leq |W_j^n-W_j-1^n| V(c) + |W_j^n-W_j-1^n|left|V(W_j^n)-V(c)right| \\ & + Bigg| sum_k=0^infty gamma_k^varepsilon,h rho_j+k-1^n left(left|V(W_j+k^n)-V(c)right|-left|V(W_j^n)-V(c)right|right) \\ & - sum_k=0^infty gamma_k^varepsilon,h rho_j+k^n left(left|V(W_j+k+1^n)-V(c)right|-left|V(W_j^n)-V(c)right|right) Bigg| \\ &leq 2normV_L^infty |W_j^n-W_j-1^n| \\ & + Bigg| sum_k=0^infty left(gamma_k+1^varepsilon,h-gamma_k^varepsilon,hright) rho_j+k^n left(left|V(W_j+k+1^n)-V(c)right|-left|V(W_j^n)-V(c)right|right) Bigg| \\ &leq 2normV_L^infty |W_j^n-W_j-1^n| + sum_k=0^infty left(gamma_k^varepsilon,h-gamma_k+1^varepsilon,hright) rho_j+k^n left|V(W_j+k+1^n)-V(W_j^n)right| \\ &eqqcolon L_j^n. Noting that K_j^n and L_j^n are independent of the choice of c, we take c=rho(t',x') in Lambda_T and integrate Lambda_T(W_varepsilon,h, Omega(cdot,t',cdot,x'),rho(t',x')) with respect to t',x'. Then the estimate crefeq:estm_LamT yields &int_0^Tint_R Lambda_T(W_varepsilon,h, Omega(cdot,t',cdot,x'),rho(t',x')) \, dx'\, dt' \\ &geq -sum_n=0^N-1 sum_jinZ K_j^n int_0^Tint_R I_j^n(t',x') \, dx'\, dt' - sum_n=0^N-1 sum_jinZ L_j^n int_0^Tint_R J_j^n(t',x') \, dx'\, dt', where we have int_0^Tint_R I_j^n(t',x') \, dx'\, dt' &leq tauint_R left| omega_delta(x_j-1/2-x') - omega_delta(x_j+1/2-x') right| \, dx' \\ &leq TV(omega_delta)htau leq frac2htaudelta, and int_0^Tint_R J_j^n(t',x') \, dx'\, dt' &leq lambda int_x_j-1/2^x_j+1/2 int_R left| omega_delta(x-x') - omega_delta(x_j+1/2-x') right| \, dx' \, dx \\ & + int_t_n^t_n+1 int_0^T left| omega_delta_0(t-t') - omega_delta_0(t_n+1-t') right| \, dt' \, dt \\ &leq lambda\, TV(omega_delta) int_x_j-1/2^x_j+1/2 |x-x_j+1/2| \, dx + TV(omega_delta_0) int_t_n^t_n+1 |t-t_n+1| \, dt \\ &leq frachtaudelta + fractau^2delta_0, implying that int_0^Tint_R Lambda_T(W_varepsilon,h, Omega(cdot,t',cdot,x'),rho(t',x')) \, dx'\, dt' geq -frac2htaudelta sum_n=0^N-1 sum_jinZ K_j^n - left( frachtaudelta + fractau^2delta_0 right) sum_n=0^N-1 sum_jinZ L_j^n. We then estimate sum_jinZ K_j^n &= 2normV_L^infty sum_jinZ |W_j^n-W_j-1^n| + \|V'\|_L^infty sum_k=0^infty gamma_k^varepsilon,h sum_jinZ |W_j+k^n-W_j^n| \\ &= left( 2normV_L^infty + \|V'\|_L^infty sum_k=0^infty kgamma_k^varepsilon,h right) sum_jinZ |W_j+1^n-W_j^n| \\ &leq left( 2normV_L^infty + c_gamma \|V'\|_L^infty fracvarepsilonh right) TV(rho_0), with c_gamma specified in crefass:gamma-mom, and sum_jinZ L_j^n &= 2normV_L^infty sum_jinZ |W_j^n-W_j-1^n| + sum_k=0^infty left(gamma_k^varepsilon,h-gamma_k+1^varepsilon,hright) sum_jinZ rho_j+k^n left|V(W_j+k+1^n) -V(W_j^n)right|. Using crefeq:TV-p1 in creflm:use_for_tv, we derive &sum_k=0^infty (gamma_k^varepsilon,h-gamma_k+1^varepsilon,h) sum_jinZ rho_j+k^n left| V(W_j+k+1^n) - V(W_j^n) right| \\ &leq sum_jinZ left( sum_k=0^infty left(gamma_k^varepsilon,h-gamma_k+1^varepsilon,hright) left(sum_l=0^k rho_j+l^nright) right) left|V(W_j+1^n) -V(W_j^n)right| \\ &= sum_jinZ W_j^n left|V(W_j+1^n) -V(W_j^n)right| \\ &leq \|V'\|_L^infty sum_jinZ |W_j+1^n-W_j^n|, and thus sum_jinZ L_j^n leq left( 2normV_L^infty + \|V'\|_L^infty right) sum_jinZ |W_j+1^n-W_j^n| leq left( 2normV_L^infty + \|V'\|_L^infty right) TV(rho_0) . Finally, we deduce the following estimate on Lambda_delta,delta_0: Lambda_delta,delta_0(W_varepsilon,h,rho) &= int_0^Tint_R Lambda_T(W_varepsilon,h, Omega(cdot,t',cdot,x'),rho(t',x')) \, dx'\, dt' \\ &geq -frac2htaudelta N left( 2normV_L^infty + c_gamma \|V'\|_L^infty fracvarepsilonh right) TV(rho_0) \\ & - left( frachtaudelta + fractau^2delta_0 right) N left( 2normV_L^infty + \|V'\|_L^infty right) TV(rho_0) \\ &= - T left( left(frac6hdelta+frac2taudelta_0right) normV_L^infty + left(frac2c_gammavarepsilondelta+frachdelta+fractaudelta_0right)\|V'\|_L^inftyright) TV(rho_0). ulineStep 4. Putting together the above estimates, we have &\|W_varepsilon,h(T-,cdot)-rho(T,cdot)\|_L^1 \\ &leq (c_gammavarepsilon+h) TV(rho_0) + left(2 delta+delta_0\|V\|_W^1,inftyright) TV(rho_0) + (delta_0+tau) normV_W^1,infty TV(rho_0) \\ & + T left( left(frac6hdelta+frac2taudelta_0right) normV_L^infty + left(frac2c_gammavarepsilondelta+frachdelta+fractaudelta_0right)\|V'\|_L^inftyright) TV(rho_0). By taking appropriate delta and delta_0 to optimize the right-hand side, we conclude that \|W_varepsilon,h(T-,cdot)-rho(T,cdot)\|_L^1 leq Kleft( varepsilon+h+sqrtvarepsilon\, T+sqrth\,T right)\, TV(rho_0), for all varepsilon,h>0 and T=Ntau>0, where the constant K>0 only depends on lambda, \|V\|_L^infty, \|V'\|_L^infty, and c_gamma. For an arbitrary time T>0, let NinN_+ be chosen such that Ntaule T<(N+1)tau. Then, by the construction of W_varepsilon,h in crefeq:W_piece_recon, we have W_varepsilon,h(T,cdot)=W_varepsilon,h(Ntau,cdot). A triangle inequality yields \|W_varepsilon,h(T,cdot)-rho(T,cdot)\|_L^1 leq& \|W_varepsilon,h(Ntau-,cdot)-rho(Ntau,cdot)\|_L^1 \\ & + \|W_varepsilon,h(Ntau,cdot)-W_varepsilon,h(Ntau-,cdot)\|_L^1 + \|rho(T,cdot)-rho(Ntau,cdot)\|_L^1, where the first term on the right-hand side is bounded by Kleft( varepsilon+h+sqrtvarepsilon\, T+sqrth\,T right)\, TV(rho_0) using crefeq:conv_rate, the second term by taucdotnormV_W^1,infty TV(rho_0) using the temporal TV-estimate crefeq:TVD-t-general in creflm:TVD-t-general, and the last term also by taucdotnormV_W^1,infty TV(rho_0) using a temporal TV-estimate of rho (see, e.\,g., ), leading to the desired conclusion.

nodes.name: Comparison with the literature
nodes.statement: Let us offer some additional comments comparing our version of Kuznetsov's argument to the ones in . First, we stress that deals with partial_t rho_varepsilon(t,x) + partial_xBig(Vbig(W_varepsilon[rho_varepsilon](t,x))\,f(rho_varepsilon(t,x))Big) = 0, & (t,x)in R_+ times R, \\ rho_varepsilon(0,x) = rho_0(x), & xinR, while both and this work focus on a special case of crefeq:cle_general where f(xi) coloneqq xi, giving crefeq:cle. There are subtle differences between crefeq:cle_general and the special case crefeq:cle: when f is a nonlinear function, crefeq:cle_general is a nonlinear conservation law even if Vbig(W_varepsilon[rho_varepsilon]) is replaced by a given velocity field. As a result, weak solutions of crefeq:cle_general are non-unique in general; then specifies the following entropy condition to select a physically meaningful one: &int_0^inftyint_R eta(rho_varepsilon)partial_tphi + psi(rho_varepsilon) Vbig(W_varepsilon[rho_varepsilon]big) partial_xphi \,\, dx\,\, dt \\ & -int_0^inftyint_R big( eta'(rho_varepsilon)f(rho_varepsilon) - psi(rho_varepsilon) big) partial_x Vbig(W_varepsilon[rho_varepsilon]big) phi \,\, dx\,\, dt + int_R eta(rho_0(x))phi(0,x)\,mathrm dx geq0, where (eta,psi) is an entropy-entropy flux pair with psi'(xi)=eta'(xi)f'(xi), and the convergence rate estimate of numerical schemes is via Kuznetsov-type arguments based on crefeq:entropy_d1. In contrast, the weak solutions of crefeq:cle are unique (as shown in ) and there is no need for entropy conditions and crefeq:entropy_d1 is automatically satisfied by the unique weak solution. In and this work, the concern is about showing that the local entropy condition holds for the local limit of nonlocal solutions of crefeq:cle, i.\,e., int_0^inftyint_R eta(rho^ast)partial_tphi + psi(rho^ast)partial_xphi \,\, dx\,\, dt + int_R eta(rho_0(x))phi(0,x)\,mathrm dx geq0, where (eta,psi) is an entropy-entropy flux pair with psi'(xi) = eta'(xi)\,(V(xi)\,xi)'. In the case where f(xi)coloneqq xi, the entropy conditions crefeq:entropy_d1 and crefeq:entropy_d2 are incompatible: one cannot directly pass a limit from crefeq:entropy_d1 to crefeq:entropy_d2 because partial_x Vbig(W_varepsilon[rho_varepsilon]big) becomes singular as varepsilonsearrow0.

nodes.name: Proof of \cref{th:main-2}
nodes.statement: As shown in creflm:limit, the approximate solution W_varepsilon,h is strongly pre-compact in L^1_loc, thus having a limit point as varepsilon,hsearrow0. The fact that the limit point is the (unique) entropy solution of crefeq:cl is proven in creflem:entropy_admissibility-2. As a consequence of the uniqueness of entropy solutions, we deduce (owing to Uryshon's subsequence principle) that the whole family (not just up to subsequences) converges. Finally, the convergence rate estimate is proven in crefth:rate.

Let us consider the numerical solutions \rho_j^n\_jinZ^ngeq0 and \W_j^n\_jinZ^ngeq0 constructed with the numerical scheme crefrangeeq:godunoveq:ini_cond_discrete, and let rho_varepsilon,h and W_varepsilon,h be the piecewise constant reconstructions of \rho_j^n\_jinZ^ngeq0 and \W_j^n\_jinZ^ngeq0, respectively, i.\,e., rho_varepsilon,h &coloneqq sum_n=0^infty sum_jinZ rho_j^n cdot mathds1_[ntau,(n+1)tau[times[(j-frac12)h,(j+frac12)h[, \\ W_varepsilon,h &coloneqq sum_n=0^infty sum_jinZ W_j^n cdot mathds1_[ntau,(n+1)tau[times[(j-frac12)h,(j+frac12)h[. nodes.statement: The assumptions used in crefth:main-2 are satisfied. In particular, the conditions crefrangeeq:geometric-gammaeq:geometric-gamma-assm on quadrature weights imply crefrangeass:pos-monoass:gamma-mom. We observe that the only additional claims in crefth:main-1 compared to crefth:main-2 concern the convergence of rho_varepsilon,h and the convergence rate estimate in crefeq:conv-rho. These follow directly from the conclusions of crefth:main-2 (namely, from crefeq:conv-W-exp), thanks to creflm:limit-same, which holds due to the relation crefeq:exp-form3. Indeed, for every varepsilon,h > 0 and t > 0, we compute \|rho_varepsilon,h(t,cdot) - rho(t,cdot) \|_L^1 &le \|W_varepsilon,h(t,cdot) - rho(t,cdot) \|_L^1 + \| W_varepsilon,h(t,cdot) - rho_varepsilon,h(t,cdot) \|_L^1 \\ &le Kleft( varepsilon + h + sqrtvarepsilon\, t + sqrth\, t right) TV(rho_0) + cvarepsilon\, TV(rho_0), where we used the triangle inequality, crefeq:conv-W-exp, creflm:limit-same, and the spatial TV-estimate in creflm:TVD-x.

nodes.name: CFL conditions
nodes.statement: The maximum principle in creflem:maxm_prcp is a prerequisite for all results in this work, and so is the CFL condition crefass:CFL-max. The spatial TV-estimate in creflm:TVD-x-2 needs a stronger CFL condition stated in crefass:CFL, which is thus used in the statement of crefth:main-2. On the other hand, in the specific case of the exponential kernel, the CFL condition crefass:CFL-max is sufficient for the same spatial TV-estimate in creflm:TVD-x, and thus crefth:main-1 holds.

The conclusion of crefth:main-1 then holds, provided that the spatial mesh size h does not exceed the nonlocal horizon varepsilon. Hence, we achieve conditional asymptotic compatibility.

nodes.statement: &partial_t eta(rho_varepsilon) + partial_x psi(rho_varepsilon)\\ &= eta'(rho_varepsilon) partial_x big( rho_varepsilon (V(rho_varepsilon) - V(W_varepsilon)) big) \\ &= eta'(rho_varepsilon) partial_x rho_varepsilon (V(rho_varepsilon) - V(W_varepsilon)) + eta'(rho_varepsilon) rho_varepsilon partial_x (V(rho_varepsilon) - V(W_varepsilon)) \\ &= partial_x eta(rho_varepsilon) (V(rho_varepsilon) - V(W_varepsilon)) + eta'(rho_varepsilon) rho_varepsilon partial_x (V(rho_varepsilon) - V(W_varepsilon)) \\ &= partial_x big( eta(rho_varepsilon)(V(rho_varepsilon) - V(W_varepsilon)) big) + big( eta'(rho_varepsilon) rho_varepsilon - eta(rho_varepsilon) big) partial_x (V(rho_varepsilon) - V(W_varepsilon)) \\ intertext(using \( P(xi) = xi\,eta'(xi) - eta(xi) \)) &= partial_x big( eta(rho_varepsilon)(V(rho_varepsilon) - V(W_varepsilon)) big) + big( P(rho_varepsilon) - P(W_varepsilon) big) partial_x (V(rho_varepsilon) - V(W_varepsilon)) \\ & + P(W_varepsilon) partial_x (V(rho_varepsilon) - V(W_varepsilon)) \\ intertext(using \( Q'(xi) = P(xi) V'(xi) \)): &= partial_x big( eta(rho_varepsilon)(V(rho_varepsilon) - V(W_varepsilon)) big) + partial_x big(Q(rho_varepsilon) - Q(W_varepsilon) big) + V'(W_varepsilon) big( P(W_varepsilon) - P(rho_varepsilon) big) partial_x W_varepsilon \\ &= partial_x big( eta(rho_varepsilon)(V(rho_varepsilon) - V(W_varepsilon)) + Q(rho_varepsilon) - Q(W_varepsilon) big) + frac1varepsilon V'(W_varepsilon) big( P(W_varepsilon) - P(rho_varepsilon) big)(W_varepsilon - rho_varepsilon),
nodes.raw_latex:
\begin{align*}
&\partial_t \eta(\rho_\varepsilon) + \partial_x \psi(\rho_\varepsilon)\\
&= \eta'(\rho_\varepsilon) \partial_x \big( \rho_\varepsilon (V(\rho_\varepsilon) - V(W_\varepsilon)) \big) \\
&= \eta'(\rho_\varepsilon) \partial_x \rho_\varepsilon (V(\rho_\varepsilon) - V(W_\varepsilon)) + \eta'(\rho_\varepsilon) \rho_\varepsilon \partial_x (V(\rho_\varepsilon) - V(W_\varepsilon)) \\
&= \partial_x \eta(\rho_\varepsilon) (V(\rho_\varepsilon) - V(W_\varepsilon)) + \eta'(\rho_\varepsilon) \rho_\varepsilon \partial_x (V(\rho_\varepsilon) - V(W_\varepsilon)) \\
&= \partial_x \big( \eta(\rho_\varepsilon)(V(\rho_\varepsilon) - V(W_\varepsilon)) \big) + \big( \eta'(\rho_\varepsilon) \rho_\varepsilon - \eta(\rho_\varepsilon) \big) \partial_x (V(\rho_\varepsilon) - V(W_\varepsilon)) \\
\intertext{(using \( P(\xi) = \xi\,\eta'(\xi) - \eta(\xi) \))}
&= \partial_x \big( \eta(\rho_\varepsilon)(V(\rho_\varepsilon) - V(W_\varepsilon)) \big) 
+ \big( P(\rho_\varepsilon) - P(W_\varepsilon) \big) \partial_x (V(\rho_\varepsilon) - V(W_\varepsilon)) \\
&\qquad + P(W_\varepsilon) \partial_x (V(\rho_\varepsilon) - V(W_\varepsilon)) \\
\intertext{(using \( Q'(\xi) = P(\xi) V'(\xi) \)):}
&= \partial_x \big( \eta(\rho_\varepsilon)(V(\rho_\varepsilon) - V(W_\varepsilon)) \big) 
+ \partial_x \big(Q(\rho_\varepsilon) - Q(W_\varepsilon) \big)
+ V'(W_\varepsilon) \big( P(W_\varepsilon) - P(\rho_\varepsilon) \big) \partial_x W_\varepsilon \\
&= \partial_x \big( \eta(\rho_\varepsilon)(V(\rho_\varepsilon) - V(W_\varepsilon)) + Q(\rho_\varepsilon) - Q(W_\varepsilon) \big)
+ \frac{1}{\varepsilon} V'(W_\varepsilon) \big( P(W_\varepsilon) - P(\rho_\varepsilon) \big)(W_\varepsilon - \rho_\varepsilon),
\end{align*}

nodes.statement: Noting that 0leqrho_j^n,W_j^nleq1 for all j,n (from creflem:maxm_prcp and crefrk:W), it suffices to show crefeq:discrete-entropy for cin(0,1). From crefeq:godunov, we write rho_j^n+1 = rho_j^n+lambda left( (rho_j-1^n-c) V(W_j^n) - (rho_j^n-c) V(W_j+1^n) + c left(V(W_j^n)-V(W_j+1^n)right) right), which implies |rho_j^n+1-c| &leq lambda V(W_j^n) |rho_j-1^n-c| + left| left(1-lambda V(W_j+1^n)right) (rho_j^n-c) + lambda c left(V(W_j^n)-V(W_j+1^n)right) right|. We denote Rcoloneqq (1-lambda V(W_j+1^n)) (rho_j^n-c) + lambda c (V(W_j^n)-V(W_j+1^n)) and discuss the following cases. [label=ulineCase arabic*.] item If W_j+1^n>W_j^n>c, we have \[ left|V(W_j^n)-V(W_j+1^n)right| = V(W_j^n)-V(W_j+1^n) = left|V(W_j+1^n)-V(c)right| - left|V(W_j^n)-V(c)right|, \] yielding |R| leq left(1-lambda V(W_j+1^n)right) |rho_j^n-c| + lambda c left(left|V(W_j+1^n)-V(c)right| - left|V(W_j^n)-V(c)right|right). item If W_j+1^n<W_j^n leq c, we have \[ left|V(W_j^n)-V(W_j+1^n)right| = V(W_j+1^n) - V(W_j^n) = left|V(W_j+1^n)-V(c)right| - left|V(W_j^n)-V(c)right|, \] which also yields crefeq:R_estm. item If W_j^n>c and W_j+1^nleq W_j^n, the identity crefeq:exp-form3 implies rho_j^ngeq W_j^n>c, and consequently \[ left|V(W_j^n)-V(c)right| leq left|V(rho_j^n)-V(c)right| leq \|V'\|_L^infty |rho_j^n-c|. \] Let R_1coloneqq left(1-lambda V(W_j+1^n)right) (rho_j^n-c) + lambda c left(V(W_j^n)-V(c)right), using the CFL condition crefass:CFL-max, we have lambda cleft|V(W_j^n)-V(c)right| leq left(1-lambda V(W_j+1^n)right) |rho_j^n-c|, thus sgnR_1=sgnrho_j^n-c=1 and |R| &leq R_1 + lambda c left|V(W_j+1^n)-V(c)right| \\ &= left(1-lambda V(W_j+1^n)right) (rho_j^n-c) + lambda c left(V(W_j^n)-V(c)right) + lambda c left|V(W_j+1^n)-V(c)right| \\ &= left(1-lambda V(W_j+1^n)right) |rho_j^n-c| - lambda c left|V(W_j^n)-V(c)right| + lambda c left|V(W_j+1^n)-V(c)right|; so we still obtain crefeq:R_estm. item If W_j^n leq c and W_j+1^ngeq W_j^n, by similar arguments as in crefit:c3, we obtain rho_j^nleq W_j^n leq c and sgnR_1=sgnrho_j^n-c=-1, giving |R| &leq -R_1 + lambda c left|V(W_j+1^n)-V(c)right| \\ &= -left(1-lambda V(W_j+1^n)right) (rho_j^n-c) -lambda c left(V(W_j^n)-V(c)right) + lambda c left|V(W_j+1^n)-V(c)right| \\ &= left(1-lambda V(W_j+1^n)right) |rho_j^n-c| - lambda c left|V(W_j^n)-V(c)right| + lambda c left|V(W_j+1^n)-V(c)right|; so we still obtain crefeq:R_estm. In summary, the estimate crefeq:R_estm holds in all cases, and it gives |rho_j^n+1-c| & leq |rho_j^n-c| + lambda Big( |rho_j-1^n-c| V(W_j^n) - |rho_j^n-c|V(W_j+1^n) \\ & - c left(left|V(W_j^n)-V(c)right| - left|V(W_j+1^n)-V(c)right|right) Big) \\ &= |rho_j^n-c| + lambda big(Psi_c(rho_j-1^n, W_j^n) - Psi_c(rho_j^n, W_j+1^n)big). Therefore, we deduce the discrete entropy inequality crefeq:discrete-entropy.

Let us assume that \cref{ass:V} holds, the nonlocal kernel $\gamma \coloneqq \mathds{1}_{]-\infty,0]}(\cdot) \exp(\cdot)$, and the initial data $\rho_0,\, \widetilde{\rho}_0$ satisfy \cref{ass:ic} with $\rho_0-\widetilde{\rho}_0\in\mathrm{L}^1(\mathbb{R})$. Let $\rho_{\varepsilon}, \, \widetilde{\rho}_\varepsilon$ be the solutions of \cref{eq:cle}, with the nonlocal impacts $W_{\varepsilon},\, \widetilde{W}_\varepsilon$ defined as in \cref{eq:W}.
Then the following $\mathrm{L}^1$-contraction property holds: 
\[
\|W_\varepsilon(t,\cdot) - \widetilde{W}_\varepsilon(t,\cdot)\|_{\mathrm{L}^1} \le \|W_{\varepsilon}(0,\cdot) - \widetilde{W}_{\varepsilon}(0,\cdot)\|_{\mathrm{L}^1}.
\]
